item.description: This free crochet tutorial shows how to make the interlocking block stitch step-by-step. It includes detailed photo instructions. item.title: CJAYG = Continuous-Join-As-You-Go 🧶 Instead of stitching all your squares together later, you join them as you crochet
item.description:
CJAYG = Continuous-Join-As-You-Go 🧶 Instead of stitching all your squares together later, you join them as you crochet the final round. It’s faster and way more fun with fewer ends to weave in!

item.title: Ammonite Fossil Granny Square Crochet Pattern
item.description: This granny square features an ammonite design on its center, perfect for fossil lovers and paleontology enthusiasts. It serves as almost a mystical reminder of a world gone by, of a distant era nearly unimaginable to us now. A blanket made with these squares would be perfect in a home inspired by Victorian explorers, among many other styles! Due to the nature of how the ammonite is constructed this isn't a pattern for beginners, but should be attempted by more advanced crocheters. The central part of this square is made with two yarns worked simultaneously in turn in a spiral, so no final row stitch counts are written, beware. The square works up beautifully with any earth toned and neutral scrap yarns you might have laying around. This 7-page digital PDF contains row-by-row crochet

item.title: Pumpkin Granny Square Crochet Pattern: Easy Fall Motif for Blanket, Bag, or Cardigan (English PDF Download)
item.description: Crochet this pumpkin granny square just in time for Fall! This pattern is suitable for advanced beginners since it only uses basic stitches and shaping. The square is very quick to make and does not require sewing. The best part is that the stem and leaf are worked after the granny square so you will not have to change colors in the middle of a round! Because of its smaller size, the pumpkin granny square is a great motif for small granny square projects, such as bags and cushion covers. You can also crochet these squares using cotton yarn to turn them into coasters for Halloween or Thanksgiving decor! This is a listing for a crochet pattern. NOT a physical item. This pattern is in English and uses US terminology. Abbreviations are included. Skill level: 2 - Easy Materials: Worsted weight
